description:
Analyze the traffic patterns in the capture file '/home/ga/Documents/captures/200722_tcp_anon.pcapng' to identify bursts and idle periods. 

You must produce a text report saved to '/home/ga/Documents/traffic_rate_report.txt'. 

The report MUST contain the following fields, each on a new line in the format 'LABEL: value':

1. CAPTURE_DURATION_SECS: Total duration in whole seconds (floor of last_timestamp - first_timestamp)
2. TOTAL_PACKETS: Total number of packets
3. AVERAGE_PPS: Average packets per second (total_packets / duration), rounded to 2 decimal places
4. PEAK_PPS: Maximum packets observed in any single one-second interval
5. PEAK_SECOND: The second offset (0-indexed) when the peak occurred (if tied, use earliest)
6. IDLE_SECONDS: Count of one-second intervals with zero packets
7. BURST_THRESHOLD: Calculated as floor(AVERAGE_PPS * 2)
8. BURST_COUNT: Number of one-second intervals where packet count >= BURST_THRESHOLD

Appended to the end of the report, provide a section header 'PER_SECOND_DATA:' followed by the packet count for every second from 0 to CAPTURE_DURATION_SECS-1, one per line in the format 'second_offset packet_count'.
